profile.headline: Software Engineer at John Deere
profile.summary:
In love with learning and the power of ideas.
Aspiring engineer looking for hard problems to solve.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Productionized the proof-of-concept of a fully autonomous mower.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Engineered a solution for fast text processing for the PS data analytics department.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Restored a service that tracks abnormal CPU and memory usage in the image processing module of semi-autonomous construction machines.

positions.title: IoT Intern
positions.description: Skills: Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) · Databases · MySQL · Machine Learning

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Directed laboratory of 50 students twice a week
•	Tutored students one-on-one on sorting algorithms, GUI, etc.
•	Discussed scheduling and student progress with the professor
•	Graded student’s projects and provided constructive feedback

positions.title: Electronics Repair Freelancer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
•	Performed 25 EFI firmware BIOS unlock and MDM Remote Management DEP removal services through eBay. 
•	Rebooted computers and installed High Sierra OS.
•	Replaced broken phone screens, speakers, keyboards, batteries, etc.

positions.title: Product Manager and Sales Assistant
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
• Oversaw the production of 200lbs of organic produce from the soil phase to market.
• With a team of 15, maintained organic farms at 4 DC public schools
• Manufactured teas, seasonings, lotions, bouquets and produce to be sold at the Farmer’s Market.
